NINJA_SLAYER_ORB_SHURIKEN_ORB.title: Shuriken
NINJA_SLAYER_ORB_SHURIKEN_ORB.descriptio:
Whenever you discard a card, Shuriken attacks a random enemy and you lose 1 Shuriken.
When evoked, each stack attacks once.
Each [gold]Aim[/gold] adds 1 damage to every [gold]Shuriken[/gold] in your next volley. Consume [gold]Aim[/gold] after the volley.
